clips.title: The story
paras: At the Valley of Trials, a rune-marked summons calls new shamans to Shikrik. Gornek delivers the parchment, which begins their formal training in communion with spirits and elements.

After proving their survival skills against local wildlife, new orc shamans receive a rune-inscribed parchment from Gornek, overseer of the Valley of Trials. Its mystical writing comes from Shikrik, the valley's shaman trainer, who asks to meet the newly arrived initiate.

Meeting Shikrik begins a shaman's sacred duty to the Horde. She teaches that shamans serve as conduits for ancestral spirits and wielders of elemental wrath. Under her guidance, new shamans learn to channel spiritual energies, mend wounds, and call upon Kalimdor's natural forces.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So, you've arrived. I was beginning to wonder when you would show yourself. I sent the parchment some time ago--I wasn't sure if it had arrived.
But enough chatter... You're here because you have been chosen, chosen to lead the spiritual lives of our people.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You will be the conduit in which our ancestors communicate. You will have the power of the elements at your beck and call. Sundering your enemies will be child's play; healing your allies as easy as breathing. Keep these things in mind as you face new challenges, and come back to me as often as you'd like. I will remain here to teach you new spells and set you on the correct path when you are ready.
